normalization_plan.reason: num is a parameter whose only role is to bound the reserveTokens mint loop, so it collapses into reserveTokens
maxSupply is a parameter written directly into MAX_SUPPLY by setMaxTokenSupply, so it collapses into that function
numberOfTokensMax5 is a parameter that only drives mint's checks and loop, so it collapses into mint
baseURI_ is a parameter assigned to _baseURIExtended by setBaseURI, so it collapses into that function
tokenId is a parameter used only for the tokenURI lookup, so it collapses into tokenURI
balance is a function-local cache of address(this).balance inside withdraw, so it collapses into withdraw
supply is a function-local cache of totalSupply() inside reserveTokens, so it collapses into reserveTokens
i is the loop counter of reserveTokens with no external meaning, so it collapses into reserveTokens
_tokenURI is a function-local cache of _tokenURIs[tokenId] inside tokenURI, so it collapses into tokenURI
base is a function-local cache of the base URI inside tokenURI, so it collapses into tokenURI
